action.command:
echo "=== Web frontend login page renders (port 3000) - look for form fields ==="
curl -s -L --max-time 30 http://localhost:3000/en/admin/auth/login 2>&1 | grep -oiE 'password|email|signin|login|<form' | sort | uniq -c | head
echo; echo "=== API /admin/login (Filament) renders login form ==="
curl -s --max-time 15 http://localhost:3001/admin/login 2>&1 | grep -oiE 'Filament|password|<form' | sort | uniq -c | head
